# f5xc_aws_vpc_site_set_cloud_site_info (Resource)

AWS VPC site view defines a required parameters that can be used in CRUD, to create and manage a volterra site in AWS VPC.<br>It can be used to automatically site creation in the AWS VPC.<br><br>View will create following child objects.<br><br>* Site

To get more information about f5xc_aws_vpc_site_set_cloud_site_info, refer:

- [API documentation](https://docs.cloud.f5.com/docs-v2/api/views-aws-vpc-site)

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Aws Vpc Site Set Cloud Site Info - Full

resource "f5xc_aws_vpc_site" "site" {
  name      = "example-aws-vpc-cloud-info-hb9ck7"
  namespace = "system"

  vpc = {
    choice = {
      new_vpc = {
        name_choice = {
          autogenerate = true
        }
        primary_ipv4 = "10.10.0.0/16"
      }
    }
  }

  site_type_choice = {
    ingress_gw = {
      az_nodes = [{
        aws_az_name = "us-west-2a"
        local_subnet = {
          choice = {
            subnet_param = {
              ipv4 = "10.10.1.0/24"
            }
          }
        }
      }]
      aws_certified_hw = "aws-byol-voltmesh"
    }
  }

  deployment_choice = {
    aws_cred = {
      name      = "eric-aws-credential"
      namespace = "system"
    }
  }

  instance_type = "t3.xlarge"
  aws_region    = "us-west-2"
  ssh_key       = "ssh-rsa  y.kuo@FRVQMCXG9D"

  worker_nodes_choice = {
    no_worker_nodes = true
  }

  logs_receiver_choice = {
    logs_streaming_disabled = true
  }

  blocked_services_choice = {
    block_all_services = true
  }

  direct_connect_choice = {
    direct_connect_disabled = true
  }

  internet_vip_choice = {
    disable_internet_vip = true
  }

  egress_gateway_choice = {
    egress_gateway_default = true
  }

  security_group_choice = {
    f5xc_security_group = true
  }

  routing_type_choice = {
    f5_orchestrated_routing = true
  }

  lifecycle {
    ignore_changes = all
  }
}


resource "f5xc_aws_vpc_site_set_cloud_site_info" "example" {
```

## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) name This is the name of configuration object. It has to be unique within the namespace. It can only be specified during create API and cannot be changed during replace API. The value of name has to follow DNS-1035 format.
- `namespace` (String) namespace This defines the workspace within which each the configuration object is to be created. Must be a DNS_LABEL format. For a namespace object itself, namespace value will be ''

### Optional

- `aws_vpc_info` (Attributes) AWS VPC Site Info Config AWS VPC Site Info Config (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--aws_vpc_info))
- `direct_connect_info` (Attributes) Direct Connect information Direct Connect information obtained after creating the site and TGW (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--direct_connect_info))
- `timeouts` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--timeouts))
